cases.refreshed: Storytime is a fun and interactive experience for a mix of ages. The whole family can take part in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities. This program promotes the joys of reading and learning for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers! Stay after storytime for our Stay and Play session, where kids can enjoy hands-on activities, toys, and social playtime together. Free, with limited capacity. Seating is first come, first served. The library hands out a limited number of tickets at the information desk 30 minutes before storytime. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.sourceText: Storytime is a fun and interactive experience designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities. This program promotes the joys of reading and learning for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers! Stay after storytime for our Stay and Play session, where kids can enjoy hands-on activities, toys, and social playtime together. Free, with limited capacity. Seating for Storytime is available on a first-come, first-served basis. A limited number of tickets will be distributed at the Information Desk 30 minutes prior to the start of Storytime. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Children of all ages and their families can build early literacy skills through stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement. This program is geared for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers. Free. Capacity is limited to 50 participants. Tickets are required to enter. Seating for Storytime is available on a first-come, first-served basis. The event description says ticket pickup at the Information Desk starts when the library opens. The signup instructions say 30 minutes before storytime. Confirm the pickup time with Pearl Avenue Library. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Join us for a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of learning for all ages. Music & Movement is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities through songs, rhymes, finger plays, and movement activities. This program is geared for children of all ages and their parents/caregivers. San José Public Library Storytimes are in alignment with the City's Education and Digital Literacy Initiative.

cases.refreshed: Stories, stretches, and sports-themed activities for tots on the move! Parents/caregivers must stay and participate with their children. This program is for children between 18 months and 4 years old. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
